_comment: Perf gate targets for the context-fabric mapped engine on BHSA (cfabric_benchmarks.perf_gate --assert). per_call_us: first-call budgets over small node sets (they include one-time index builds such as the section tables behind T.nodeFromSection), µs/call. steady_state_us: absolute steady-state ceilings, µs/call, well above current values so any machine passes but a per-call corpus scan (milliseconds) fails. steady_state_vs_tf: steady-state per-call latency (and N.walk_full_s) must stay within max_ratio times the TF steady state in bhsa_tf.json (refresh it on the gating machine); overrides cover the two calls that build fresh Python ints where TF returns pre-built tuples (L.u, N.walk). rss_load_delta_mb: peak-RSS growth caused by opening the corpus; rss_final_mb: peak RSS after the whole run (dominated by the 424,698 result tuples of q_feat_empty_qere and the N.walk tuple). queries_le_tf: every gate query within query_max_ratio_vs_tf of the TF wall time in bhsa_tf.json.
